meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did I find out about it from his phone?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
A single edit. Which date, and where is the page? I'm not taking your word for it, so turn the screen.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." That's your whole position after a minute ago? My being happy isn't the issue, Hale. If the zero is coming off, I want it in writing today and I want to know whether anything has gone on his record, because I'm still going to the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You said you would remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still want the withdrawal confirmed in writing, along with confirmation that nothing has gone on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology, and confirmation that nothing is on Owen's record, with the principal still next if she doesn't get it.
What moved her: Nothing did, because the version history with 612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM came with no date and no page she could check for herself.
What cost ground: Offering to remove the zero just to keep her happy gave up the whole case without anything having been checked, and it showed her a position that wasn't held firmly.
Try next time: When she asked which date and asked to see the page, answer with the date and turn the screen, instead of dropping the case a moment later.
